messages:
Jordan (CS): Quick flag 1: onboarding batch jobs for several EU trials failed to index embeddings into search; customers seeing empty results and some 502s. We need a one-paragraph status to send to impacted accounts + a make-good offer. Can Eng confirm root cause and ETA?
Evelyn (Eng): Triage summary: a nightly schema migration partially applied which left the indexer expecting a different header format. Indexer dropped those documents causing soft-failures. We've rolled back the migration and kicked targeted reindexes. Current reindex progress ~48% and throughput throttled to avoid downstream pressure.
Tom (SRE): Cluster stabilized at 10:14 UTC after rollback. No signs of data loss or unauthorized access. We've disabled the problematic migration job and added a canary check to CI. Monitoring: https://internal.metrics/redwood/indexing/471234. Expect full catch-up within 2-4 hours.
Jordan (CS): Draft customer-safe note: 'We're investigating an issue that caused some newly ingested embeddings not to appear in search. Engineering has identified and rolled back the change; we are replaying affected data and expect full restoration shortly. No customer data exposure. We're offering credits and dedicated troubleshooting sessions for affected accounts. A full RCA will follow within 48 hours.' Approve?
Evelyn (Eng): Approve. Add a short self-check customers can run after we confirm recovery: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' -d '{"input":"check"}' | jq '.status'``` expecting "ok" and successful search hit for that vector.
Harpreet (AM): I'll prepare tailored outreach to the top 10 impacted trials and flag accounts with renewals in next 90 days. Proposed make-good: $200 credit + 30-min troubleshooting + priority reindex. Any objections?
Tom (SRE): Fine from SRE side. Also ask customers to provide a failing job id or sample payload if available so we can validate in replays.
NotifyBot: Reindex jobs started for tenants: t-eu-78, t-eu-92, t-eu-114. Job progress=18% ETA=02:30:00
Jordan (CS): Action items: 1) Harpreet send the comms + credits offer and invite to office hours 2) CS paste any incoming payloads/job ids into tracker https://docs.internal/cs/471234-feedback 3) Eng/SRE finish RCA draft and share in #postmortems. I'll monitor replies and flag any renewal risk accounts for escalation.
Harpreet (AM): Sending now. Will paste replies here as they come in.
Evelyn (Eng): Reindex at 65% and no new failures. Planning to release a small validation script customers can run once we report recovery.
Jordan (CS): Thanks team. Keep this thread updated with any customer replies or changes to ETA.
